extension_name.description: Extension name shown in the browser and store.

extension_description.message: On-page toolbelt: scroll markers, freehand brush, global memo, calculator, and multi-term search.
extension_description.description: Extension description shown in the browser and store.

panel_collapse_title.description: Tooltip on the button that closes the expanded panel.

panel_collapse_aria.description: Accessible label for the button that closes the expanded panel.

coming_soon.description: Placeholder text for a feature that is not yet implemented.

help_intro.message: Open any tool by pressing its button on the right-side rail. Marker and Brush are volatile tools that disappear when you leave the page.
help_intro.description: Intro paragraph at the top of the Help panel.

help_marker_desc.message: Bookmark scroll positions. Use '+ Add mark' to save the current scroll position, then click an item in the list to jump back to it. Rename (pencil) and delete individually, up to 10. Volatile: cleared when you leave the page.
help_marker_desc.description: Help description for the Marker feature.

help_brush_desc.message: A pen for drawing freely over the page. Adjust color and width, with eraser and clear-all support. Draws only while the shortcut key (backtick ` by default) is held. Volatile (memory only).
help_brush_desc.description: Help description for the Brush feature.

help_memo_desc.message: A single global memo shared across every site. Saves automatically as you type.
help_memo_desc.description: Help description for the Memo feature.

help_calculator_desc.message: A basic calculator in the style of the Windows calculator. Keeps a recent calculation history you can review.
help_calculator_desc.description: Help description for the Calculator feature.

help_multi_search_desc.message: Highlight multiple terms on the page at once (similar to Ctrl+F). A different color per term, ▲▼ to move between matches, up to 10 terms.
help_multi_search_desc.description: Help description for the Multi-search feature.
